Preserve original facial identity, original softly rounded eyes, small natural mouth, delicate nose, original head/body proportion and soft painterly fine anime linework. Character: 雪璃 / xueli. long flowing pale-blue curly hair, softly rounded cyan-blue eyes, silver star ornaments and mint ribbons. Keep original gentle face and faint cheek blush. Outfit: CHANGE THE ENTIRE CLOTHING to a distinct traveling UNIFORM: pale aqua tailored button-up jacket, white high-collar blouse, fitted long navy TROUSERS, silver star buttons, leather utility belt, small satchel and practical ankle boots. NO dress, NO skirt, NO exposed thighs, NO ceremonial veil. Blue curly hair with small silver star clips remains; cyan lantern at belt. Do not retain the original ceremonial cleric gown. The silhouette must clearly differ from the regular and home dresses; no sword or tail. Pose2: MOSTLY FRONT-FACING, only a gentle 15 to20 degree torso/hip yaw toward viewer's left, both shoulders and almost the entire front bodice remain visible. One hand lightly touching her collar/ribbon at chest, other arm naturally relaxed. Face almost directly toward viewer with a small natural head tilt. Use the supplied VN screenshot only as a reference for this mild body angle, not for character identity or clothing. NOT a strong three-quarter view, NOT profile, NOT back-facing, NOT looking back over the shoulder, NO twisted neck or crossed legs. Exactly two arms and hands. Expression: calm natural neutral expression, gently open eyes and a tiny closed mouth, soft restful eyebrows, faint original natural blush. Natural high-quality Galgame expression, never plastic glossy eyes, mismatched facial cutouts, generic floating eyes, broad huge mouth, realistic face, flat mask or facial assembly. Full figure from complete hair tip to shoes, centered, transparent margins on all sides. Crisp delicate cloth folds, ornaments and natural anatomically correct hands. Soft consistent diffuse lighting. Real transparent alpha PNG background, no scenery, ground shadows, text, labels, atlas, sheet, collage or extra person.
